entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Nullability analysis fails to recognize any form of non-boxing union access pattern with member provider interface #85767
  • TestLaunchWithCustomEnvironmentVariable integration test is failing #85765
    18.11
  • Some CSharpQuickInfo integration tests are failing #85764
    18.11
  • Compiler stack overflow on self-referential nullable union with updated-memory-safety-rules #85762
  • LocalRewriter.InterceptCallAndAdjustArguments possibly adds unsupported values to `argumentRefKindsOpt` array #85759
  • No test coverage for a code path in `CodeGenerator.HasHome` #85757

PullRequests

Created

  • Skip remaining failing integration tests #85766
  • FileBasedProgramsEntryPointDiscovery: Use File.Move instead of File.Replace for cache file #85763
    VSCode
  • Bound RunTests timeout dump collection #85761
  • Normalize interceptor argument ref kinds for reduced extension calls #85760
  • Add coverage for StrictIn local home handling #85758
  • Unsafe evolution: suppress "unnecessary unsafe" #85756
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix build warnings #85754
    VSCode
  • Avoid dereferencing a reference assigned to a discard #85750
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Read Razor asset-path metadata from the code document #85738
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Snap skill: add arcade subscriptions #85753
    Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85712
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85752

Updated

  • Update Gladstone and related SDK assemblies #85748
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Add exclude_single_letter_parameters option to CA1704 #85161
    Community
  • Fix ref safety analysis of mutable non-assignable receivers #85730
    Area-Compilers
  • File-based apps: load #:ref projects #85260
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Format multiline paste in XML documentation comments #84737
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Don't report CA1704 for numeric type parameter names (T1, T2, …) #85162
    Area-Analyzers, Community
  • Consolidate warn-as-error flags in build scripts #85261
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix RpcServer response-write race that can crash BuildHost on shutdown #85749
    VSCode
  • Add on-demand project loading #85234
    VSCode
